resources.string: To show you around Settings, Tic needs LibreWrist\'s accessibility service. It only looks at the Settings screens that LibreWrist opens, and it never taps anything that deletes data or confirms security on its own.
If the switch is greyed out: open App info, tap ⋮ and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Lets Tic, the LibreWrist guide, point at and tap the steps of LibreWrist\'s setup in Settings. It only works while a guided step is open and reads nothing else.
Wake Tic up so it carries on
